youtube.title: GPS差百萬分之一秒就偏三百公尺？藍點跳對街的真相｜原來如此事務所
youtube.description:
走在大樓中間，手機地圖上的 GPS 藍點突然跳到對街、叫車司機停在對面，重開地圖還等超久！其實 GPS 衛星根本不知道你在哪，手機算位置靠的竟然全是「時間」——只差百萬分之一秒，光就跑掉約 300 公尺！
用一場「公園哨子遊戲」一次看懂：衛星像燈塔單向廣播、高空原子鐘一天快約 38 微秒的相對論修正、為什麼一定要第四顆衛星幫手機對錶、衛星本身精準到 65 公分卻被高樓玻璃牆多路徑反彈甩飛、電離層雙頻修正，以及輔助 GPS 用網路偷吃步為何得把時間當成第五個未知數！

📚 參考研究與官方出處：
- GPS.gov (GPS Accuracy & Space Segment & FAQ)：https://www.gps.gov/node/70
- FAA (Satellite Navigation - GPS - How It Works)：https://www.faa.gov/about/office_org/headquarters_offices/ato/service_units/techops/navservices/gnss/gps/howitworks
- U.S. DoD GPS SPS Performance Standard (5th ed., 2020)：https://www.gps.gov/node/205
- ESA Navipedia (Code Based Positioning, Multipath, Ionospheric Delay, TTFF)：https://gssc.esa.int/navipedia/index.php/Code_Based_Positioning_(SPS)
- Ashby N. (2003) Relativity in the Global Positioning System：https://link.springer.com/article/10.12942/lrr-2003-1
- Blay R., Wang B. & Akos D. M. (2021) Assisted GNSS, NAVIGATION：https://navi.ion.org/content/68/1/217
- van Diggelen F. & Enge P. (2015) World's first GPS MOOC (4.9 m mean)：https://www.ion.org/publications/abstract.cfm?articleID=13079

scenes.chapter: 衛星根本不知道你在哪，它只像燈塔一直喊時間

data.prompt: Medium shot on the sunlit sidewalk with generous headroom, 2.5-head chibi 8-year-old girl with generous headroom, glossy black bob with straight bangs and top cowlick, wide bright dark-brown aligned eyes, rosy cheeks, ink-navy toggle raincoat with bright mustard hood, five clean fingers, tilting her head upward toward the bright sky while holding up her small phone in one five-fingered hand.

lines.speaker: kid
lines.text: 等等，難道不是我的手機發訊號去問天上衛星「我現在在哪裡」，衛星再算完傳回來給我嗎？

data.prompt: Wide shot vibrant daylight coastal cliff metaphor blended with sky: a miniature luminous satellite beaming one-way golden light pulses downward like a classic striped lighthouse toward a quiet tiny phone resting on green grass below.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 剛好相反！衛星根本不知道你在哪，它像海邊燈塔只管一直往下廣播，手機只聽不說話，自己算出位置。

data.prompt: Wide shot sunny neighborhood park lawn: a shiny silver whistle resting on a sunlit wooden park bench sending visible rippling pearlescent sound rings across bright green grass toward a plain two-hand wristwatch on a blanket.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 就像看到閃電數打雷！用「公園哨子遊戲」想：朋友戴準錶整點吹哨，你盯自己手錶算晚幾秒，就能推他多遠。

data.prompt: Close-up luminous cartoon satellite floating gently above Earth's curved bright blue horizon: a radiant crystalline golden precision clockwork core glowing warmly inside its transparent body, zero digits.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 天上的 GPS 衛星就是那個吹哨的朋友！它飛在兩萬公里高空，身上帶著非常準的「原子鐘」，訊號裡寫著發射時刻。
lines.say: 天上的 G P S 衛星就是那個吹哨的朋友！它飛在兩萬公里高空，身上帶著非常準的「原子鐘」，訊號裡寫著發射時刻。

data.prompt: Wide shot vertical cutaway from starry bright upper atmosphere down to a sunlit city park: a brilliant golden beam streaking smoothly downward from a cute golden-winged satellite straight to a tiny phone on the ground.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 這道光速哨聲從高空飛下來，只要六十到九十毫秒——連十分之一秒都不到，對時間精準度的要求誇張到極點！

data.prompt: Medium shot inside the sunlit office with generous headroom, 2.5-head chibi 8-year-old girl with generous headroom, glossy black bob with straight bangs and top cowlick, wide bright dark-brown aligned eyes, rosy cheeks, ink-navy toggle raincoat with bright mustard hood, five clean fingers, leaning forward with raised skeptical eyebrows pointing playfully toward a cartoon satellite figurine on the table.

lines.speaker: kid
lines.text: 連十分之一秒都不到！那開頭說衛星上的原子鐘每天會變快，這麼準的鐘怎麼可能自己走偏？

data.prompt: Close-up storybook Earth-and-orbit tabletop scene: a glowing golden pocket watch orbiting high above Earth's curved blue rim ticking slightly brisker with warm amber aura than an identical pocket watch resting on the green ground below.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 還真的會偏！照相對論，高空地球拉得沒那麼用力讓鐘走快，衛星飛很快又讓它走慢，兩邊一抵消還是走快了。

data.prompt: Close-up bright laboratory workbench: a sleek golden-winged satellite resting on a sunlit oak stand while delicate brass calibration screwdrivers gently tune its glowing crystal clock core before launch.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 每天快約三十八微秒，光夠跑十一公里多！好在衛星上天前會先調慢，上太空也會廣播修正值。

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 鐘校準後怎麼找位置？回到公園，只聽一人吹哨不知方向、你會落在一整圈，疊三人才縮成一個點！
lines.say: 鐘、叫準後怎麼找位置？回到公園，只聽一人吹哨不知方向、你會落在一整圈，疊三人才縮成一個點！

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 換到立體太空，三顆衛星的距離畫出三個球面，交會出地球上跟外太空兩個點——排除掉外太空那點就鎖定你！

scenes.chapter: 第四顆衛星竟是來對錶？兇手就站在玻璃牆邊！

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 回到哨子遊戲，想像三位朋友在不同方向吹哨：要是你手錶慢了一秒，你會誤以為每個哨聲都少跑一秒！

lines.text: 聲音每秒約走三百多公尺，三位朋友聽起來全變近三百多公尺，三個圈圈一起縮太小，當場完全交不到一起！
lines.say: 聲音每秒約走三百多公尺，三位朋友聽起來、全部變近三百多公尺，三個圈圈一起縮太小，當場完全交不到一起！

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 解法超聰明：換回太空的衛星，手機把「東西、南北、高低」加上「自己錶差多少」當四個未知數，多聽第四顆一起算！

data.prompt: Close-up glowing editorial visual on daylight grey: six luminous golden satellite beams converging cleanly toward a small phone, gently balancing around one crisp emerald glow point representing their best compromise fit.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 手機其實不是真的在畫球面，而是同時解這四個答案；為了讓全球到處能收至少四顆，天上排了二十四個衛星位置！

data.prompt: Medium shot on the sunlit sidewalk between smooth glass towers with generous headroom, 2.5-head chibi 8-year-old girl with generous headroom, glossy black bob with straight bangs and top cowlick, wide bright dark-brown aligned eyes, rosy cheeks, ink-navy toggle raincoat with bright mustard hood, five clean fingers, holding up her small phone with raised eyebrows looking eagerly at Chief.

lines.speaker: chief

scenes.chapter: 不只反彈，大樓把天空夾成一條縫還有第二擊

data.prompt: Wide low-angle upward shot standing between two towering smooth modern glass skyscrapers in Taipei sunlight: the bright blue sky above is squeezed into one narrow vertical ribbon with only a couple tiny golden satellites visible.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 更雪上加霜的是大樓還會直接擋掉衛星！抬頭看天空只剩一條細縫，能用的衛星一變少，原本小誤差就更容易被放大。

lines.text: 不一樣！衛星全被逼在頭頂同一條窄縫裡，就像朋友全擠同側吹哨，測距偏一點交點就整片滑開，甚至算不出座標！

lines.text: 那剛剛說訊號得穿過大氣層，高空大氣會不會其實也是把我的藍點甩去對街的幫兇之一？

lines.text: 但衛星廣播附了電離層修正參數，估計修掉約一半；像聽高低兩支哨子般收雙頻，更能清掉九成九以上！

lines.text: 更重要的是，高空電離層是整片天空慢慢變，不會在兩棟大樓間突然跳動——所以甩飛藍點的，多半不是天上，而是牆邊！

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 平常若剛定位過，手機還留著先前存好的衛星位置能秒開；不然就是靠「輔助 GPS」，直接用行動網路搶先下載！
lines.say: 平常若剛定位過，手機還留著先前存好的衛星位置能秒開；不然就是靠「輔助 G P S」，直接用行動網路搶先下載！

data.prompt: Close-up warm sunlit park bench: a small phone popping up a crisp glowing golden park map sketch showing tiny pins for each friend, while just one brief sparkling whistle chime flashes from afar.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 就像有人先傳訊息告訴你每位朋友站在哪，你不用傻傻等他們一個字一個字報地址，只要聽幾毫秒衛星訊號就能算！

data.prompt: Medium shot inside the sunlit office with generous headroom, 2.5-head chibi 8-year-old girl with generous headroom, glossy black bob with straight bangs and top cowlick, wide bright dark-brown aligned eyes, rosy cheeks, ink-navy toggle raincoat with bright mustard hood, five clean fingers, narrowing her eyes like a sharp little detective pointing one clean finger upward.

lines.speaker: kid
lines.text: 聽起來超作弊耶！直接用網路先拿衛星位置、跳過那段慢慢念的廣播，難道完全沒有代價嗎？

data.prompt: Close-up dramatic orbital studio scene: a golden-winged satellite zooming swiftly forward along a glowing cyan arc while a slightly delayed ghost silhouette trails noticeably behind it, stretching a red distance ribbon.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 代價又繞回時間！沒讀廣播就少了精確時刻，導航期刊論文回顧指出：衛星飛超快，時間每差一秒距離就錯約八百公尺！

data.prompt: Wide shot glowing daylight-blue sky dome: five gleaming golden satellites shining down five crisp luminous emerald rays onto one small phone, lighting up a radiant five-point balance star around it.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 好在手機知道衛星飛多快，於是乾脆把「精確時間」變成第五個未知數一起解——代價就是至少要收到五顆衛星！

data.prompt: Medium shot inside the sunlit wooden office with generous headroom, 2.5-head chibi Taiwanese office chief woman with generous headroom, dark brown-black low side ponytail with silver-grey streak, round black glasses, warm brown aligned eyes, bare clean ears, mustard-yellow knitted cardigan over white shirt, dark navy trousers, five clean fingers, smiling knowingly while holding up five clean fingers beside her brass pocket watch.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 你平常在街角一打開地圖就秒跳出來的藍點，很可能就是靠這招，把五個答案一口氣算出來。

data.prompt: Medium shot on the sunlit park path entering bright green trees with generous headroom, 2.5-head chibi 8-year-old girl with generous headroom, glossy black bob with straight bangs and top cowlick, wide bright dark-brown aligned eyes, rosy cheeks, ink-navy toggle raincoat with bright mustard hood, five clean fingers, gasping delightedly with wide sparkling eyes looking down at her phone.

lines.speaker: kid
lines.text: 一邊聊著，我們不知不覺走出大樓峽谷、踏進開闊公園了——所長你看，我的藍點竟然瞬間穩下來了！

data.prompt: Medium shot inside the sunlit wooden office with generous headroom, 2.5-head chibi Taiwanese office chief woman with generous headroom, dark brown-black low side ponytail with silver-grey streak, round black glasses, warm brown aligned eyes, bare clean ears, mustard-yellow knitted cardigan over white shirt, dark navy trousers, five clean fingers, resting her chin warmly on one hand with a playful encouraging smile.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 從高樓峽谷走到這片草地，藍點表現判若兩人——你有沒有發現，改變的其實不是天上衛星，而是你周圍的環境？

scenes.chapter: 走到公園想通了：手機每次定位都在幫自己對錶

data.prompt: Medium shot in the bright sunny green park with generous headroom, 2.5-head chibi 8-year-old girl with generous headroom, glossy black bob with straight bangs and top cowlick, wide bright dark-brown aligned eyes, rosy cheeks, ink-navy toggle raincoat with bright mustard hood, five clean fingers, beaming with a huge joyful eureka grin while holding up her small phone whose blue dot sits rock-steady on the green lawn.

lines.speaker: kid
lines.text: 原來如此！衛星從頭到尾都在高空準時廣播，決定藍點準不準的，全是手機看得到多少片乾淨天空！

data.prompt: Wide shot vibrant golden-hour neighborhood park lawn beneath a wide crystal-blue open sky: four gleaming golden satellites shining clean unbroken rays down onto a calm steady blue dot on a park bench phone.

lines.speaker: kid
lines.text: 以後我再也不冤枉手機地圖壞掉了——它只是站在兩面玻璃高牆夾縫裡，被周圍環境考倒了而已！

data.prompt: Medium shot inside the warm golden-hour wooden office with generous headroom, 2.5-head chibi Taiwanese office chief woman with generous headroom, dark brown-black low side ponytail with silver-grey streak, round black glasses, warm brown aligned eyes, bare clean ears, mustard-yellow knitted cardigan over white shirt, dark navy trousers, five clean fingers, smiling warmly behind her oak desk holding up the gleaming silver whistle and golden pocket watch.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 說得太棒了！還記得公園遊戲裡那支慢一秒的錶嗎？我覺得最神奇的是：手機每次定位，其實都在順手幫自己對錶。

data.prompt: Close-up cozy golden-hour oak tabletop: a small phone showing a steady glowing blue dot resting peacefully beside a finely crafted brass pocket watch catching warm amber afternoon sunbeams.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 靠著高空裡的原子鐘和光速算術，每一次抓座標，都是把天上跟掌心的時間精準扣在一起。

data.prompt: Wide shot warm sunny Taipei street corner just outside an open plaza: a cheerful yellow taxi pulling up smoothly right next to a glowing blue pin on the bright open sidewalk.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 下次在高樓林立的街口叫車，要是藍點又突然跳去對面，多往開闊路口走幾步，你馬上就知道怎麼幫它看清天空！

data.prompt: Medium shot inside the sunlit wooden office with generous headroom, 2.5-head chibi Taiwanese office chief woman with generous headroom, dark brown-black low side ponytail with silver-grey streak, round black glasses, warm brown aligned eyes, bare clean ears, mustard-yellow knitted cardigan over white shirt, dark navy trousers, five clean fingers, facing the viewer with a warm approachable smile and one open welcoming hand (five clean fingers), clean plain wooden wall behind.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 最後問問你：你在哪裡遇過地圖藍點亂跳、害外送或計程車停錯邊的糗事？留言分享給大家聽！

data.prompt: Medium shot inside the sunny wooden studio with floating golden dust motes and generous headroom, 2.5-head chibi 8-year-old girl with generous headroom, glossy black bob with straight bangs and top cowlick, wide bright dark-brown aligned eyes, rosy cheeks, ink-navy toggle raincoat with bright mustard hood, five clean fingers, smiling joyfully and waving goodbye with one raised clean five-fingered hand.

lines.speaker: kid
lines.text: 喜歡把天天用卻沒細想過的科技原理拆個徹底，別忘了訂閱原來如此事務所，我們下次見！
